items.title: CFTC halts some Kalshi Trump mention markets over manipulation concerns
items.content: The CFTC stayed Kalshi’s Trump-related mention markets after raising concerns about manipulation risks, giving the platform until Dec. 11 to defend its contracts.

items.title: Maple Finance CEO targets up to $15B in assets by the end of 2027
items.content: Sidney Powell aims to reach $15 billion in assets under management by the end of 2027 as the firm looks to expand into tokenized lending and traditional finance.

items.title: Eastern Europe crypto flows fall 7.9% as Ukraine draws $12B in stablecoins
items.content: Chainalysis found that Eastern Europe recorded the steepest decline in crypto activity of any region, while cross-border stablecoin transfers to Ukraine continued amid the ongoing war.

items.title: Lighter incident exposes risks beyond withdrawal controls
items.content: Crypto platforms need enforceable limits on every route an API key can use to transfer value, including trades, internal transfers and shared pools.

items.title: Fed’s Waller cites Binance hack in warning over tokenized finance
items.content: Fed Governor Christopher Waller questioned who bears responsibility for fraud, compromised keys and failed transactions as traditional financial assets move onto blockchains.

items.title: Bitcoin drops 2.5% as Nvidia stock risks new 5-month lows into Q3 earnings
items.content: Bitcoin price downside sees local lows of $63,269 as Nvidia stock targets $150 as traders brace for volatility over Q3 earnings.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.content: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Solana Foundation takes majority interest in crypto data firm CoinGecko
items.content: Solana Foundation now holds a majority interest in CoinGecko, its product chief said, as the crypto data platform explores trading features.

items.title: Bitcoin to $1M by 2030? ‘Almost certainly not,’ says Dragonfly’s Qureshi
items.content: Dragonfly’s Haseeb Qureshi says Bitcoin could reach $400,000 by 2030 but doubts it will return to $100,000 by year-end with the rout in AI stocks weighing on crypto.

items.title: ARK sells $85M in Nvidia shares ahead of chipmaker’s Q3 earnings results
items.content: ARK bought shares in Block, Circle and Coinbase worth about $39.9 million at Monday’s close while selling Nvidia and Solana and Ether staking ETFs.

items.title: Revolut plans four blockchain-based funds for private markets, chair says
items.content: Citing a looming liquidity crunch, Martin Gilbert said blockchain could help bring more liquidity to private markets.

items.title: US senators seek SEC answers on tokenized stock money laundering risks
items.content: Four Democratic senators asked who would be responsible for tokenized shares transferred outside regulated platforms and whether the SEC could freeze or recover those tokens.

items.title: BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF snaps $2.35B outflow streak amid extreme fear
items.content: BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF ended 11 sessions of withdrawals totaling $2.35 billion, but CryptoQuant says one day of inflows is too early to signal a recovery.

items.title: Bitcoin realized loss metric beats June high as open interest eyes 2-year low
items.content: Bitcoin short-term holders’ onchain spending notched the largest proportion of realized losses since February after BTC/USD dropped to $62,000.

items.title: Google says hackers use AI agents to find and exploit software flaws
items.content: Google says attackers are using AI agents to find and exploit software flaws automatically, reducing the time organizations have to apply patches.

items.title: US judge clears brothers in $25M Ethereum MEV case after mistrial
items.content: Judge Jessica Clarke said the transactions did not involve false promises, but the ruling did not determine whether the brothers’ conduct was ethical or violated other laws.

items.title: Goldman Sachs reports $1.22B in Ether ETFs as ETHA share count jumps
items.content: Goldman Sachs increased its Ether ETF shares in Q3, bringing its reported holdings to $1.22 billion, while reshuffling its Bitcoin ETF positions.

items.title: Ex-Robinhood engineer pleads guilty to $125K Hyperliquid trading scheme
items.content: The former Robinhood engineer used confidential information about upcoming Robinhood token listings to trade on Hyperliquid.

items.title: Trezor customer data exposed in 3rd partner breach this year
items.content: Trezor warned an attacker has been able to access customer names, phone numbers and delivery addresses linked to 27,000 orders from one of its shipping providers.

items.title: Hackers inject credit card, crypto-stealing malware into 178 major websites
items.content: Ledger and Coinpass were among the businesses whose websites served malware designed to steal visitors’ crypto and credit card details, according to security researchers.

items.title: Nvidia shares fall 4% as board reportedly rules out Huang return
items.content: The chipmaker’s board is reportedly focused on investigating Huang’s conduct, even as a petition calling for his reinstatement gathers more than 187,000 signatures.

items.title: Custodia Bank loses Supreme Court bid for direct Fed payment access
items.content: The Supreme Court refused to hear Custodia Bank’s appeal, meaning a lower court ruling allowing the Fed to reject account applications will stand.

items.title: German lawmakers back crypto freezes outside criminal cases
items.content: Customs authorities could hold “suspicious” assets for 30 days under the bill, with court oversight for extensions and disputed confiscation.

items.title: Binance hack may push institutions to outside custody, FalconX exec says
items.content: FalconX’s Joshua Lim says the Binance hack could push institutions to keep crypto off exchanges and change how large investors trade in 2027.

items.title: Bitmine edges toward 5% of ETH supply as treasuries report buys amid market slump
items.content: Strategy, Strive, Bitmine and Cypherpunk disclosed fresh additions to their crypto treasuries, spanning Bitcoin, Ether and Zcash.

items.title: Boris Johnson says UK must lead blockchain development despite crypto doubts
items.content: Johnson was joined by Lord Ross Kempsell who called for regulators to work with industry participants to bring the UK to the forefront.

items.title: Coinbase and Broadridge propose standard for tokenized stock disclosures
items.content: The proposed standard aims to connect tokenized stockholders with corporate disclosures and voting materials across digital wallets, but would not create shareholder rights.

items.title: Nvidia turmoil tests Bitcoin miners’ AI funding plans
items.content: Nvidia’s leadership upheaval and Texas permit restrictions sharpen the divide between miners with funded projects and those still seeking capital and approvals.

items.title: Safe wallet reportedly loses $6.5M as Zodiac suspects key compromise
items.content: Zodiac’s co-founder said a likely compromised key and overly permissive wallet settings enabled the theft, rather than a flaw in its smart contracts.

items.title: Bitcoin price fails to hold $65K as US stocks drop further on AI nerves
items.content: Bitcoin and US equities saw pressure to start the week as traders weighed the impact of forthcoming Nvidia Q3 earnings and Anthropic’s IPO announcement.
